tools.name: capture_browser_scenario
tools.scope: Chromium 145 launch mode with an owned temporary profile; live navigation to example.org, a wait action, captured URL and DOM, owned-browser termination. Missing executable rejected. Web content is untrusted and this test is not a general browser guarantee.

tools.name: extract_artifact
tools.scope: Extracted two regular files from a local controlled ZIP; REA reported verified containment and complete covered entries; independent Python ZIP byte/hash oracle passed; cleanup verified. Negative no active archive returns target_unavailable.

limitations: Browser tested on a public documentation example domain; do not use that destination for recurring monitoring.
Archive test does not establish handling of ZIP non-entry bytes.
